sql: SELECT country FROM singer WHERE age > 40 INTERSECT SELECT country FROM singer WHERE age < 30;
SELECT T2.Name, T2.Country FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID WHERE T1.name ILIKE '%Hey%';
SELECT StuID, weight FROM Pets WHERE pet_age > 1;
SELECT StuID FROM Has_Pet JOIN Pets ON Has_Pet.PetID = Pets.PetID JOIN Student ON Has_Pet.StuID = Student.StuID WHERE Student.LName = 'Smith';
SELECT COUNT(*), StuID FROM Has_pet GROUP BY StuID;
SELECT Model FROM car_names ORDER BY Horsepower LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT maker) FROM car_makers WHERE YEAR = 1970;
SELECT T2.CountryName FROM car_makers AS T1 JOIN countries AS T2 ON T1.Country = T2.CountryId GROUP BY T1.Country, T2.CountryName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(weight), YEAR FROM cars_data GROUP BY YEAR;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data WHERE Cylinders > 6;
SELECT MAX(T1.MPG) FROM cars_data AS T1 JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.MakeId WHERE T2.Cylinders = 8 OR T2.Year < 1980;
SELECT Country FROM airlines WHERE Airline = 'JetBlue Airways';
SELECT Abbreviation FROM airlines WHERE Airline = 'JetBlue Airways';
SELECT Airline FROM airlines WHERE Abbreviation = 'UAL';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airlines WHERE country = 'USA';
SELECT T2.AirportName FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airportcode = T2.destairport WHERE T1.city = 'Aberdeen';
SELECT airportname FROM airports WHERE city = 'Aberdeen';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport = T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City = 'ATO';
SELECT T2.AirportCode FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.DestAirport = T2.City GROUP BY T1.SourceAirport, T2.AirportCode ORDER BY COUNT(*) LIMIT 1;

SELECT airline FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airlines AS T2 ON T1.Airline = T2.uid WHERE T1.DestAirport = 'CVO' EXCEPT SELECT T2.Airline FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airlines AS T2 ON T1.Airline = T2.uid WHERE T1.SourceAirport = 'APG';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee;
SELECT city FROM employee GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT COUNT(*), LOCATION FROM shop GROUP BY LOCATION;
SELECT T2.name, T2.district FROM shop AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.shop_id = T2.shop_id ORDER BY T1.number_products DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT District FROM shop WHERE Number_products < 3000 INTERSECT SELECT District FROM shop WHERE Number_products > 10000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOCATION) FROM shop;
SELECT T1.Document_id, T2.Template_id, T2.Document_Description FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Templates AS T2 ON T1.template_id = T2.template_id WHERE T1.document_name = 'Robbin CV';
SELECT Template_ID, VERSION_NUMBER, Template_Type_Code FROM Templates;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Templates WHERE Template_type_code = 'CV';
SELECT Template_Type_Code, Template_Type_Description FROM Ref_template_types;
SELECT T2.Paragraph_ID, T2.Paragraph_Text FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID WHERE T1.Document_Name = 'Welcome to NY';
SELECT T1.Document_ID FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.Document_ID GROUP BY T1.Document_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
SELECT T1.Document_ID, T1.Document_Name FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Paragraphs AS T2 ON T1.Document_ID = T2.document_id GROUP BY T1.Document_ID, T1.Document_Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT document_id FROM paragraphs GROUP BY document_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 2;
SELECT name FROM teacher WHERE hometown <> 'Little Lever Urban District';
SELECT name FROM teacher WHERE age = 32 OR age = 33;
SELECT T2.Hometown FROM course AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID = T2.Course_ID GROUP BY T2.Teacher_ID, T2.Hometown HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
SELECT open_year, num_of_staff FROM museum WHERE name = 'Plaza Museum';
SELECT SUM(Total_spent) FROM visit AS T1 JOIN visitor AS T2 ON T1.visitor_id = T2.ID WHERE T2.Level_of_membership = 1;
SELECT T2.first_name, T2.birth_date FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.country_code = 'USA';
SELECT AVG(loser_age), AVG(winner_age) FROM matches;
SELECT COUNT(*), ranking_date FROM rankings GROUP BY ranking_date;
SELECT COUNT(*), YEAR FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR;
SELECT MAX(t1.note), MIN(t1.note) FROM death AS t1 JOIN battle AS t2 ON t1.caused_by_ship_id = t2.id;
SELECT name, result FROM battle WHERE bulgarian_commander <> 'Boril';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses;

SELECT T1.department_name, T1.department_id FROM DEPARTMENTS AS T1 JOIN DEGREE_PROGRAMS AS T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.department_id GROUP BY T1.department_id, T1.department_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.section_name, T1.section_description FROM TRANSCRIPT_CONTENTS AS T1 JOIN SECTIONS AS T2 ON T1.student_course_id = T2.course_id;
SELECT department_description FROM departments WHERE department_name ILIKE '%computer%';
SELECT T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id = T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_summary_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.semester_name FROM Semesters AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.semester_id = T2.semester_id EXCEPT SELECT T1.semester_name FROM Semesters AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.semester_id = T2.semester_id;
SELECT T1.transcript_date, T1.transcript_id FROM TRANSCRIPTS AS T1 JOIN SECTION AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id = T2.section_id GROUP BY T1.transcript_id, T1.transcript_date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

SELECT T1.address_id, T1.line_1, T1.line_2 FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.address_id = T2.permanent_address_id GROUP BY T1.address_id, T1.line_1, T1.line_2 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT section_name FROM sections WHERE course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM courses WHERE course_name = 'h');
SELECT title FROM Cartoon WHERE directed_by = 'Ben Jones';
SELECT Title FROM Cartoon WHERE Directed_by = 'Ben Jones';
SELECT T2.series_name FROM Cartoon AS T1 JOIN TV_Channel AS T2 ON T1.Channel = T2.id WHERE T1.Title = 'The Rise of the Blue Beetle!';
SELECT Episode, Rating FROM TV_series ORDER BY Rating DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT MIN(Share), MAX(Share) FROM TV_series;
SELECT T2.Series_name FROM TV_series AS T1 JOIN TV_channel AS T2 ON T1.Channel = T2.id WHERE T1.Episode = 'A Love of a Lifetime';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poker_player;
SELECT T2.Name FROM poker_player AS T1 JOIN people AS T2 ON T1.People_ID = T2.People_ID WHERE T1.Earnings > 300000;
SELECT Nationality, COUNT(*) FROM people GROUP BY Nationality;
SELECT Name FROM people WHERE Nationality <> 'Russia';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Nationality) FROM people;
SELECT vote_id, phone_number, state FROM votes;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contestants WHERE contestant_number NOT IN (SELECT contestant_number FROM votes);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE GovernmentForm = 'Republic';
SELECT population, gnp FROM country WHERE continent = 'Asia' ORDER BY gnp DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(COUNT(*)) FROM countrylanguage AS T1 JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code2 WHERE T2.Name = 'Aruba';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countrylanguage AS T1 JOIN language AS T2 ON T1.Language = T2.Name WHERE T2.Name = 'English' INTERSECT SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countrylanguage AS T1 JOIN language AS T2 ON T1.Language = T2.Name WHERE T2.Name = 'Dutch';
SELECT t1.Language FROM country AS t2 JOIN countrylanguage AS t1 ON t2.Code = t1.CountryCode WHERE t2.Continent = 'Asia' AND t1.IsOfficial = 'T' ORDER BY t2.Population DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT c.GovernmentForm, SUM(population) FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage l ON c.Code = l.CountryCode GROUP BY c.GovernmentForm HAVING AVG(l.Percentage) > 72;
SELECT c.Language FROM country c JOIN countrylanguage l ON c.Code = l.CountryCode GROUP BY c.CountryCode, c.Language ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conductor;
SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Age ASC;
SELECT Name FROM conductor EXCEPT SELECT Name FROM conductor WHERE Nationality = 'USA';
SELECT name, grade FROM highschooler;
SELECT id FROM highschooler WHERE name = 'Kyle';
SELECT grade FROM highschooler GROUP BY grade HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4;
SELECT T2.name, COUNT(*) FROM likes AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.friend_id = T2.friend_id GROUP BY T2.name;
SELECT T2.name FROM likes AS T1 JOIN highschooler AS T2 ON T1.friend_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.name FROM likes AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.friend_id JOIN Highschooler AS T3 ON T3.id = T2.student_id WHERE T3.name = 'Kyle';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.friend_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM Friend WHERE T2.friend_id = 'Kyle');
SELECT id FROM highschooler WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM Friend);
SELECT T2.name, COUNT(*) FROM likes AS T1 JOIN highschooler AS T2 ON T1.friend_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.name;
SELECT T1.name FROM highschooler AS T1 JOIN likes AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.friend_id WHERE T1.grade > 5 GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.friend_id WHERE T2.student_id = 1;

SELECT T1.name FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id EXCEPT SELECT T1.name FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id WHERE T2.date_of_treatment > '2010-01-01';
SELECT first_name FROM owners EXCEPT SELECT first_name FROM professionals;
SELECT first_name FROM owners EXCEPT SELECT T1.first_name FROM owners AS T1 JOIN professionals AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id;
SELECT T1.role_code, T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.email_address FROM professionals AS T1 JOIN treatments AS T2 ON T1.role_code = 'Veterenarian' AND T2.dog_id IS NULL;

SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name FROM Treatments AS T1 JOIN Professionals AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id WHERE T1.date_of_treatment < (SELECT AVG(date_of_treatment) FROM Treatments);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Treatments AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id;
SELECT name, age, weight FROM Dogs WHERE abandoned_yn = 1;
SELECT AVG(age) FROM Dogs;
SELECT MAX(charge_amount) FROM charges;
SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Birth_Year = 1948 OR Birth_Year = 1949;
SELECT COUNT(*), citizenship FROM singer GROUP BY citizenship;
SELECT property_type_description FROM Ref_Property_Types;
